commentary_title: Positive sentiments likely to push up freight rates next week
commentary_summary: The Suezmax market had a slow week with freight rates declining on most routes. Despite this, the utilisation of vessels for this segment has been continuously rising as activity continues to be stable with more vessels being fixed at lower rates. | The market towards the MEG showed some improvement last week with more enquiries expected to push up rates next week. Similarly, a good level of enquiries towards West Africa for transatlantic voyages are expected to push up rates next week due to a decline in the tonnage supply.
